scripts.codegen:check: pnpm run codegen && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check-generated-code
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.quality: pnpm run codegen:check && pnpm run schema:check && pnpm test && pnpm run build
